capabilities: Add and update hierarchical numbering on Markdown headers
Set font family and size for headers and document titles
Control numbering per file via YAML frontmatter
Bulk apply or remove numbering across the vault
extras: README warns to back up the vault before bulk numbering operations and lists a known issue with the default tab-character separator; old YAML keys (first-level, max) are deprecated.
intentEvidence: enhances markdown headers with automatic numbering, intelligent backlink management, and custom fonts
problem: Obsidian does not automatically number headings or keep [[file#header]] links in sync when header text changes, and header font styling requires manual CSS.
summary: Header enhancement plugin that adds hierarchical auto-numbering to Markdown headers, updates header links, and customizes header fonts.
